description:
## Source
The ksge-engine "sub-game subsystem" vertical slice (engagement ksge-eng-5sp, now CLOSED) was, by design, ALSO a battle-test of the post-debloat Stoa substrate. Full gauntlet (STRABO→DAEDALUS→ARGUS→ADA→VERA→CATO→NOMOS→ZENO) ran across 3 phases + 2 repos. Consolidated by CAPTAIN_CURATOR; routed here by user-tier POLYBIUS as the engagement close-out.

## Battle-test verdict
Substrate is SOUND. Every defect is MINOR — no seat stalled or produced wrong work due to substrate friction; the team self-healed every coordination snag (PLINY-not-polling stall, two-POLYBIUS confusion, relay ownership) WITHOUT a substrate change. Defects are calibration polish; the positives are the higher-value half.

## Full artifact (the routing-ready detail — read this)
`C:\Users\denso\claude_projects\ksge-engine\agents\observation\ksge-eng-5sp\consolidated-substrate-friction.md`
(by substrate target; each item = statement · evidence · severity · suggested fix + owner.)

## Defects (all MINOR) — by target
1. **CAPTAIN role files:** D1 STRABO §6.3 — prefer `gh api`/Bash over WebFetch for GitHub/npm facts (both 403 WebFetch). D2 ARGUS §4-no-Write vs §7-mandates-save-verdict coherence gap — fix once at the shared read-only-review-seat layer (also affects NOMOS/ZENO); RECURRED across 2 ARGUS dispatches. D3 bw-heartbeat carve-out for a design-only/no-bw dispatch — shared bw-contract layer.
2. **save-verdict skill:** D4 `__pycache__` pollution — skill should ship its own `.gitignore` (RECURRED across 3 seats × 2 sub-builds). D5 Windows `--body-path /tmp` → wrong-file-silent-green — CONFIRM-REPRO first (provenance: brief/bw only, NOT in any verdict; verifying seats said the skill functioned). D6 request-bead vs bare-CLI ergonomics (coupled to D5).
3. **Toolchain/verification:** D7 no headless-browser automation in the base toolchain — VERA had to hand-roll CDP for a WebGL deliverable. **Highest-leverage item; pair with P1.** Fix: a substrate-blessed headless-render probe helper OR standing guidance (`@playwright/test` channel:msedge devDep + `?e2e=` seam).
4. **Cross-repo/bw:** D8 bw heartbeat unreachable from a content-repo cwd → cross-repo briefs should pin cwd to the bw repo OR explicitly waive the heartbeat.
5. **Process/orchestration:** D9 brief-vs-spec paraphrase is a live failure mode (root cause of ARGUS B1: a brief re-enumerated the contract OUT shape + mis-attributed it to §9). The read-the-cited-spec discipline CAUGHT it — but the error originated up the dispatch chain. Fix: when a brief references a spec field set, cite the spec line; don't re-enumerate from memory.

## Positive patterns to CANONIZE (proven; promote to conventions)
- **P1** the `?e2e=` RNG-factory deterministic-real-WebGL seam — drive a real browser-render emit path to a natural outcome with ZERO synthetic input by injecting determinism at the smallest seam (one RNG site), production path + contract untouched. THE template for D7's fix.
- **P2** REVISE → delta-re-audit — the reviser writes a top-of-file "Changes from rev1" delta-log; the re-auditor audits against it (materially shortened the delta read).
- **P3** read the consumed upstream SHA LIVE at build time (execSync in vite.config, baked into the bundle + asserted by a probe) — provenance can't drift from the actual consumed commit.
- **P4** the pre-build gate (design → audit → HARD STOP before build) earned its cost — caught both Phase-1 blockers (signal-honesty) as cheap design-text fixes, no rebuild.

## Highest-leverage / safest bets
Highest leverage: **D7 + P1** (toolchain gap + its proven template). Safest fix bets (recurrence = a class, not a one-off): **D2** (2 ARGUS dispatches), **D4** (3 seats × 2 sub-builds).
